text: BAM share rose 0.12 percentage points over the last 22 hours and 0.29 percentage points over 7 days, reaching 34.6% of Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: the largest node holds 22% of BAM stake and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 71 leadership changes are best read as whale-driven routing, not validator turnover; only the fra structural rollover on 2026-06-24 has been validated, with 22 minutes of warning.
